name: "Fun" In The Woods
author: MrHuhweewi
description: This is a game I designed and made in one day. In this game "Fun" In The Woods, you have to shine your light at a clown so he doesn't kill you. Use your spacebar to turn on your flashlight. Use your mouse cursor to aim the flashlight. Don't use up all your power or the clown might get you. Hope you enjoy
